req.title: Health responds under load-balancer probe path
req.statement: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency and no external dependencies required.
triggers: health responds under load-balancer probe path

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /health/ endpoint should respond with sub-second latency and no external dependencies, returning an HTTP 2xx status code. The test suite will include a positive test to verify the expected behavior, a negative test to ensure proper error handling, and a boundary test to check performance under load.

tests.name: test_health_endpoint_positive
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /health/ endpoint.
expected: The response time is less than 1 second.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import time

client = TestClient(app)
start_time = time.time()
response = client.get('/health/')
end_time = time.time()

assert response.status_code == 200
assert (end_time - start_time) < 1

tests.name: test_health_endpoint_negative
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to an invalid endpoint /health_invalid/.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/health_invalid/')

assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_health_endpoint_boundary
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send multiple GET requests to the /health/ endpoint in quick succession.
expected: Each response time is less than 1 second.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import time

client = TestClient(app)
for _ in range(10):
    start_time = time.time()
    response = client.get('/health/')
    end_time = time.time()
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert (end_time - start_time) < 1
